clauses.clause: No new weapon anywhere; headlamp taken on approach; uncollected headlamp stays where it lies; beam follows the head (also moving one way, aiming another).
clauses.note: Both tiers: no new weapon pickup entities; uncollected headlamp remains at exact original coordinates through120 idle ticks. Normal directional input approaches it without E and collects it. Actual headlampOn becomes1; with +X movement and -X pointer aim the drawn head yaw≈-π and lighting beam[-1,0] match within1e-8. All32 current supplement captures were inspected: cyan ground ring disappears on pickup and a bright cone follows the facing head while the courier moves the other way. Fixture teleports only stage the later straight-tunnel aim check; the approach pickup uses normal input. Bar and Northgate fixtures in the same ledger do not grant a full-route or every-bar PASS.
